a: Splitting of atomic nuclei into smaller parts

e: Relativistic time dilation becomes significant when the speed of a system approaches the speed of light.

q: Uranium is used for the generation of ____. 2024,2025,2026

A mixture of stable and unstable isotopes

a bus moving at a constant speed in a straight road
a person standing on a stationary train
